/-- A non-unital non-associative commutative ring is a `NonUnitalNonAssocRing` with commutative
multiplication. -/
class NonUnitalNonAssocCommRing (α : Type u)
  extends NonUnitalNonAssocRing α, NonUnitalNonAssocCommSemiring α
